## Research Scope & Dimensions

This research investigates how academic library guides (LibGuides) frame, teach, and operationalize **Artificial Intelligence (AI) Literacy** across higher education. 

Using an LLM extraction pipeline with verbatim quote verification and high-dimensional semantic embeddings, this project investigates five core dimensions:

1. **Definitions & Conceptual Models**: Formal explicit definitions vs. implicit competencies (Leo Lo’s framework, Bloom-aligned models, ACRL threshold concepts).
2. **Instructional Objectives & Learning Outcomes**: Student skills (prompt engineering, lateral fact-checking, bias detection) and faculty pedagogical goals (assignment redesign, syllabus clarity).
3. **Institutional Guidelines & Policies**: Permitted vs. prohibited use spectra, citation protocols (APA, MLA, Chicago, IEEE), and syllabus policy tiers.
4. **Instructional Frameworks & Heuristics**: Named rubrics including the **ROBOT Test**, **CLEAR Prompting Framework**, **PAIR/PAIRR Models**, and **Lateral Reading**.
5. **Curricular Semantic Alignment**: Pairwise vector similarity and hierarchical clustering identifying pedagogical alignments (e.g., the *UC Core Cluster*, the *Pragmatic Tool Dyad*, and the *Critical Theory Outlier*).

## Synthesis Report Navigation

The findings are organized into seven dedicated sections:

:::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### [1. Executive Summary & Typology](chapters/01-executive-summary.qmd)
High-level overview of findings and the distribution across the three primary curricular typologies: *Balanced Hybrid*, *Tool-Use*, and *Critical/Ethical*.

### [2. Definitions of AI Literacy](chapters/02-definitions.qmd)
Explicit vs. implicit definitional models, conceptual taxonomies, and the intersection between AI Literacy, Information Literacy, and Digital Literacy.

### [3. Objectives & Learning Outcomes](chapters/03-objectives-outcomes.qmd)
Delineation between student competencies (prompt design, hallucination auditing, privacy safeguards) and faculty pedagogical objectives.

### [4. Policies, Guidelines & Citation](chapters/04-policies-guidelines.qmd)
Spectra of permitted vs. prohibited use, data governance, and style guide citation standards (APA, MLA, Chicago, IEEE).
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### [5. Instructional Frameworks & Heuristics](chapters/05-frameworks.qmd)
In-depth breakdown of named pedagogical models: ACRL Frames, the ROBOT Test, Lateral Reading, CLEAR framework, RTF/TAG, and Bloom's Taxonomy.

### [6. Semantic Similarity & Clustering](chapters/06-similarity-clusters.qmd)
Mathematical analysis of the high-dimensional cosine similarity matrix and hierarchical clustermap revealing institutional affinities.

### [7. Strategic Recommendations](chapters/07-recommendations.qmd)
A 5-phase evidence-based implementation roadmap for academic libraries developing or updating AI literacy programming.

### [Interactive Data Explorer](explorer.qmd)
Interactive searchable matrix and comprehensive institutional profile cards with extracted quotes and framework mappings.
:::
